The '''Cyberlegs Mod III''' were a model of [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Limb/Legends|legs]] designed to replace legs lost in an accident, but also provided greater speed than most organic legs.
The Mod III was made by [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries]], who were the leading manufacturer in cybernetic body parts, and cost 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]<ref name="EOTEC" /> as a pair, not being available singularly. The limbs were available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Cyberlegs Mod III was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2013]] and written by [[Sterling Hershey]].
